description: List law firms by name, side, district and size, most cases first. get_firm gives one firm in full.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Results per page, at most 50 (the default).

min_cases.description: At least this many cases; with side, cases on that side.

name.description: Part of the name, any case.

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

side.description: Only those with cases for this side, ranked by their cases on that side rather than by all their cases.

name: search_firms

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

cases.description: Every case the firm appeared in, as lead firm or not. The firm's other figures count only the cases it leads a side in, so their totals can be a little lower.

casesByYear.description: Cases the firm leads a side in, by the year they were filed.

defenseCases.description: Of cases, those where the firm appeared for the defense, as lead firm or not.

districts.description: Judicial districts the firm appeared in.

jurisNumber.description: Firm juris number, for get_firm and the firm filters.

kind.description: individual: a person's name rather than a firm's, such as a solo practitioner.

plaintiffCases.description: Of cases, those where the firm appeared for the plaintiff, as lead firm or not.

title: Search law firms
